prompt: The attached images are the official character portraits: keep each character's design, colors, markings and accessories exactly as in their portrait (the portraits only show the head; draw the rest of the body to match). Ignore any badge, medallion or hexagon frame around a portrait: it is not part of the character. A single comic-book panel from the cozy story mode of the game Dice Duel. It must look like the game's own art, the attached character art: a flat sticker illustration with a thick uniform dark cocoa outline (#3a2a2e) around every shape, flat color fills with ONE soft cel-shaded shadow tone and one small highlight, no gradients, no glow, no painterly texture, no realistic lighting, no 3D rendering. Only the game's palette: cream paper #fbf1df and #f1dfc2, ivory #fffaf0, sage felt greens #4e7d68 and #5f8f78, wood browns #7a4b2f and #a86c45, honey #f2b15e, coral #e8806f, rose #ec8fa8, sky blue #6fbfd3, lavender #b8a4f0, mint #8fd6a8, cocoa #3a2a2e. Backgrounds are SIMPLE: a few big flat color shapes (a wall, a floor, a window) with at most three props, no clutter, no decorative plants or mugs unless the scene asks for them. Cozy, adult, dry humor; expressive faces, not chibi, not childish. No halftone dots (they are added later), no panel border, no frame, no gutter, no white margin: the art fills the image edge to edge. No speech balloons, no captions, no sound effects and no lettering, except a sign the scene explicitly asks for. Every die is a plain six-sided cube with round pips, in its owner's color (Diana's are pink). Draw few dice, and every visible face with a correct standard pip layout: 1 = one center pip; 2 = two pips on a diagonal; 3 = three pips on a diagonal; 4 = four corners; 5 = four corners and the center; 6 = two parallel rows of three. Never more than six pips on a face, never a blank face, and two faces of the same die never show numbers that add up to 7. GUAXINIM: an anthropomorphic raccoon with the black eye mask, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie; a relaxed thief with an economic theory. SCENE: Guaxinim the raccoon sits on top of a big pile of junk at dusk (old lamps, crates, a bicycle wheel, teacups), gesturing casually at a floor lamp whose shade is a translucent plastic veterinary cone. Only three dice in the picture, one pink, one frog-green and one honey-amber, resting on the pile in front of him, drawn fairly large and clearly separated, each a plain six-sided cube. Keep the upper-right area (a third of the width, top 40%) as empty plain wall or sky for a speech balloon; the characters stay in the left 60% of the frame.
